card.name: Words just before 'conditions' or condition-state
card.fires_on: Words in a clause where the next word could plausibly be 'conditions' or 'condition', such as 'stored', 'performed' or 'extremely' after a subject about state or circumstances. It fires on verbs and adverbs that lead into 'under ... conditions'.

modes.label: Verbs before 'under conditions'
modes.description: Passive verbs about storage or handling that are usually followed by 'under ... conditions'.

modes.description: Words describing the state or condition of something, as in 'its condition was extremely fragile'.
